newsitem.title: ITALY: Mussolini granddaughter resigns from party group.
newsitem.headline: Mussolini granddaughter resigns from party group.

text.p: Alessandra Mussolini, granddaughter of fascist dictator Benito Mussolini, said on Wednesday she was resigning from the the hard-right National Alliance party's parliamentary group.

Mussolini, who has accused the party leadership of stifling internal party debate, announced she was quitting in letters addressed to party chairman Gianfranco Fini and to the Alliance leader in the lower house of parliament, Giuseppe Tatarella.
A spokeswoman for the fiery, blonde politician said Mussolini would not make public the reasons why she was standing down until after she had met party leaders.

"She has no intention, for the time being, of revealing to the press the reasons which have pushed her to resign. She will do it after giving the motives of her choice to the party leadership," the spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman added that the reasons for Mussolini's dissatisfaction were strictly political.
Fini told reporters that he would not make any comment until he had spoken to Mussolini but another party leader, Maurizio Gasparri, asked her to stay on.
